chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from his father, from Al-Muttalib ibn Ziyad, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), who said:
The best of the sauces (accompaniments) is the ghee (melted butter).

key_terms.إِدَام: Food accompaniment or side dish, typically a sauce or dip eaten with bread or main dishes.
key_terms.السَّمْن: Ghee or clarified butter, a traditional dairy product highly valued in Islamic cuisine.

ai.seo_question: What is considered the best food accompaniment according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this concise narration from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), the term 'idam' (a savory side dish or condiment) is applied to ghee, highlighting its status not merely as a staple but as a prized culinary enhancement in early Shia society. This reflects the broader Shia emphasis on *tayyibat* (pure, wholesome foods) and the appreciation of simple, natural sustenance as a form of gratitude and practical wisdom in daily life.
